cards.scope: Build additive ICP escrow accounting and backend API for ckSOL mint attempts
cards.evidenceText: Acceptance: caller confirms a maximum ICP deposit; attempt freezes quote rate and maximum; 1T cycles may be fronted only from a dedicated finite reserve, currently zero and not enabled; net minter charge is attached ICP minus refunded ICP; the user explicitly accepted the 5% service fee, measured as minter cycles only, with the separate 1B-cycle operating fee disclosed apart; automatically return unused ICP, never cycles. Preserve prior cycle-payment receipts, client funds, unknown outcomes, and safe retry. Backend source is implemented; 37 focused backend tests and source-generated Candid compatibility/regeneration checks pass. Two targeted reviews PASS after fixes: liquid backing excludes already-dispatched attachments, and both local/backend counterpart journals are checked before cross-mode approval or continuation. Branch codex/solana-icp-processing; remote CI/PR pending. Full mocked async lifecycle and authorized live canary are recorded as deferred before client money; reserve remains zero, with no production install, funding, or financial canary authorized.

cards.scope: Integrate ICP quote/consent flow and recovery path for existing SOL deposits
cards.evidenceText: Acceptance: show price, maximum ICP, 5% service charge on measured minter cycles, and separate 1B-cycle operating fee before SOL is sent; return unused ICP; provide an actionable path for people who already sent SOL. 116 focused frontend tests across six suites pass; build and auth-asset checks pass. Browser testing with simulated data and spending disabled covered desktop quote/mint/refund and 390px zero-ICP, refund, and unknown-funding states, with no horizontal overflow or relevant console errors. svelte-check still reports 30 errors and 66 warnings in 25 unrelated files, with no changed-file diagnostics. Branch codex/solana-icp-processing; remote CI/PR pending. No production install, live canary, or release is claimed; the customer's SOL location remains unverified pending identifying evidence.
